Video Content Creator & Editor (Multi-Channel, All Platforms) — Medikonda Nutrients, Hyderabad
Experience: 0–2 Years
We are looking for a creative and skilled Video Content Creator & Editor to make long form, short form and UGC videos for all our channels across all social media platforms.
Key Responsibilities
- Create and edit long form, short form and UGC videos using AI Tools for YouTube, Instagram, Pinterest, and other social media platforms.
- Produce long-form videos, YouTube Shorts, UGC Videos, Instagram Reels, Pinterest video pins, and other short-form content.
- Adapt each video to the format, size, length, and style required by each platform.
- Design eye-catching thumbnails, cover images, and supporting graphics for videos.
- Use AI tools and models such as Kling AI, Google Flow, ElevenLabs, Veo, Claude, ChatGPT for video generation, voiceovers, and content creation.
- Plan and manage a monthly video content calendar for all channels.
- Apply YouTube SEO best practices for titles, thumbnails, and Shorts to improve reach and engagement.
- Track video performance using analytics and improve content based on results.
Candidate Requirements
- Strong proficiency in Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
- Strong video editing skills with a good understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, typography, and composition.
- Proven experience creating videos for YouTube, Instagram, and Pinterest.
- Strong thumbnail design skills.
- Understanding of YouTube SEO, Shorts, and audience engagement.
- Basic knowledge of social media analytics and video performance.
- A portfolio or showreel of previous video work is required.
